📄 Document Reader – PDF Viewer & PDF Tools
This Android application adopts user-friendly navigational layouts. Users can open, preview, convert and categorize PDFs, along with diverse office documents on smartphones and tablets. Packed with abundant practical PDF functions, it lessens the difficulty of daily document processing, and suits student learning, daily office workflows as well as business-related work.

🔍 Document Viewing & Reading (Multi-format Supported)
The application launches swiftly and provides consistent, smooth browsing experience. You can access and read PDFs plus other mainstream file formats with ease. It is fully compatible with PDF, Word, Excel and PPT formats, covering nearly all commonly used office file types. This versatile document tool satisfies daily needs for opening and verifying document content.

🔄 File Conversion – PDF Conversion & Creation
This full-featured PDF toolset supports speedy format conversion for documents and images. You can effortlessly convert personal photos, JPG and PNG images into standard PDF files. A built-in camera scanning function is also provided; you are able to capture photos of physical paper documents and export these scanned copies directly in PDF format.

✂️ PDF File Management
You can utilize the app’s native tools to organize and arrange your PDF files in order. You may merge multiple separate PDF files into one whole document, or split a single PDF into several individual files. The recent files list and favorite folders allow you to locate target documents rapidly. The app can stably execute daily PDF edits and routine document processing tasks.

📁 Streamlined File Management for Higher Efficiency
The app automatically identifies all locally stored PDF files on your device and compiles them into an integrated list. You can manage all PDFs and office documents wholly within this single application. It adapts well to academic study, fixed desktop office work and outdoor mobile work scenarios, boosting your efficiency in learning and daily professional tasks.

✅ Why Choose This App
It features a tidy, uncluttered interface and straightforward operation steps, fitting the usage needs of students, office employees and anyone who regularly deals with PDF files. Download this comprehensive utility that integrates PDF browsing, PDF creation and multi-format document reading functions altogether.
